title: 第17章 要不我给你钱？
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: 这句话看似随意，实则表明了长期合作的意向。在这个粮食比金贵的年代，稳定的食物来源就是最大的资本。辰楠点点头：“有货我会找你的。”简单的几个字，却让罗八刀心中大定。他看得出来，这少年不是池中之物，今日结个善缘，来日必有回报。交易完成，气氛变得轻松。罗八刀看着满地的南瓜，脸上难得露出真切的笑容。这批南瓜品质极佳，个头大、品相好，在黑市上绝对能卖个好价钱。虽然他做的是见不得光的买卖，但多年来的经验告诉他，做生意讲究的是和气生财。有几个手下眼神闪烁，似乎在打什么主意。罗八刀立即一个眼神瞪过去，制止了他们的非分之想。他混迹江湖多年，最清楚什么样的人能惹，什么样的人不能惹。这辰楠看似普通，但能无声无息间打晕他们三个人，又敢独自前来交易，必定不是简单角色。辰楠将一切尽收眼底，心中对罗八刀的评价也高了几分。这人虽然混黑市的，但懂得审时度势，知道什么该碰什么不该碰，倒是个可以长期合作的对象。“刀哥，交易完成，我就先告辞了。”辰楠见没自已什么事，转身就想走。“等会。”罗八刀喊停，随即拿过一支手电筒递了过去。“辰小哥，这大晚上的，拿支手电回去。”辰楠愣了愣，接过手电筒，“还是刀哥想得周到。”这时候的手电筒可是稀缺货，没想到对方毫不犹豫就给他一支。“多少钱？要不我给你钱？”“看不起谁呢？”罗八刀一脸不乐意，“这个是送你的。”辰楠笑了笑没再说话，拿着手电筒离开了树林。夜色渐深，树林中只余下虫鸣声声。辰楠的身影很快消失在黑暗中，留下罗八刀和一众手下面对堆积如山的南瓜。“大哥，就这么放他走了？“一个心腹忍不住问道，“要不要派人跟着，看看他什么来路？”罗八刀摇摇头：“不必。这少年不简单，跟踪他只会打草惊蛇。咱们做生意的，讲究的是诚信。只要他还能提供货源，咱们就以礼相待。”他蹲下身，抚摸着一个个硕大的南瓜，眼中精光闪烁：“这批南瓜，足够咱们赚上一笔了。吩咐下去，明天就开始分批出手，不着急变现。”“是！”一群人齐声应道。而此时辰楠已经绕出树林，确认无人跟踪后，才放缓脚步。月光洒在他的身上，晚风轻拂，带来丝丝凉意。辰楠嘴角微扬，有了罗八刀这条线，以后出手物资就方便多了。回到家中，父母已经睡熟。辰楠轻手轻脚地回到自已房间，这才从空间里取出那沓钞票。两百零四张“大团结“在油灯下泛着诱人的光泽，这是一笔足以改变家庭命运的巨款。这钱暂时只能自已保管，若是爸妈知道，不敢想象会发生什么事。当清晨的第一缕阳光透过窗户纸照进来时，辰楠已经忙活了好一阵子。灶台上，金黄的鸡蛋拌着白面，在铁锅里烙成了香喷喷的饼子。这是他用空间里的存货做的，虽然简单，在这个年代却算得上是一顿奢侈的早餐。“哎哟，我的小祖宗！”李秀兰披着外衣从里屋出来，看见灶台上的吃食，顿时心疼得直拍大腿，“这一顿得糟蹋多少白面鸡蛋啊！”她一脸心疼的样子，看得辰楠有些好笑，“妈你就放心好了，以后我们家会越来越好的。”辰东南跟在后面，看着儿子忙碌的身影，眼中却流露出欣慰之色：“孩子有心，你就享福吧。”事已成定局，多说无益，只能先去洗漱。一家三口围坐在小桌前，辰楠给父母各盛了一大块鸡蛋饼。李秀兰小口小口地吃着，每吃一口都要念叨一句“太浪费了”。辰东南倒是吃得很香，连掉在桌上的饼渣都捡起来吃了。“爸，妈，今天我就回乡下看爷奶和妹妹们。”辰楠一边吃一边说。李秀兰连忙放下筷子，从里屋取出一个信封：“这是街道办开的介绍信，你收好了。现在出门到哪儿都要介绍信，没有这个寸步难行。”辰楠接过介绍信，小心地揣进怀里。这个年代，没有介绍信连车都坐不了，旅馆更不会收留。每个人都被牢牢地固定在户籍所在地，想要出门远行，就得靠这一纸证明。“要不我去请个假送你去坐车？”李秀兰有些担心。“不用啊！我自已去车站就行，你们安心上班。”辰楠看着父母说，“我都这么大了，能照顾好自已。”辰东南拍拍儿子的肩膀：“路上小心，到了就给家里捎个信。”饭后，老两口出门上班。辰楠站在门口，望着他们消失在胡同拐角，这才转身回屋。他从空间里取出那三十尺的浅蓝色布料。将布料放在父母房间里，又找来一张纸，工工整整地写道：“爸妈，这布是我用鱼换的，你们放心做新衣裳穿，别舍不得。爷奶和妹妹们也会有新衣服的。我会照顾好自已的，勿念。”写完字条，辰楠把早就收拾好的行囊收入空间，锁好门，朝长途汽车站走去。车站里人声鼎沸，到处都是扛着大包小包的旅客。售票窗口前排着长队，人们手里紧紧攥着介绍信和钞票。辰楠排了半个小时的队，终于买到了一张去往红星公社的车票。客车是辆老旧的解放牌大巴，车厢里挤满了人，过道上都堆满了行李。辰楠好不容易找到自已的座位，刚坐下就被一股混合着汗味、烟味和鸡鸭味的气味熏得直皱眉。车子开开停停，不断有人上车下车，车速倒是提不起来。从京城到红星公社也就四五十里地，可是却坐了一个多小时的车。可见一路上下车的人并不少，否则这点路程也不至于坐那么久的车。辰楠下车看着陌生的环境，一时间有些恍惚。荒凉破败是唯一的特色，人流与京城比起来差太远了。他四处张望寻找去胜利大队的牛车。可惜等了半天，也没见到牛车的影子。从公社到胜利大队还有十四五里路，没牛车也只能走路回去。六月的太阳毒辣得很，土路被晒得滚烫。辰楠走了快一个小时，快到家时已经是汗流浃背。他找个树荫歇歇脚，休息了十几分钟。准备出发时，忽然听见路旁的山林里传来一阵异响。“咔嚓咔嚓...”像是有什么大型动物在啃食东西。
content_en: This sentence may seem casual, but it actually expresses the intention of long-term cooperation.In this era when food is more valuable than gold, a stable source of food is the greatest capital.Chen Nan nodded: "I will find you if there is something in stock." These simple words made Luo Badao feel confident.He could see that this young man was not a creature of the pond. If he formed a good relationship today, he would be rewarded in the future.The deal is done and the atmosphere becomes relaxed.Luo Badao looked at the pumpkins on the ground with a rare genuine smile on his face.This batch of pumpkins is of excellent quality, large in size and good in appearance, and will definitely fetch a good price on the black market.Although he is engaged in shady business, his years of experience tell him that doing business is all about making money with harmony.Some of the men's eyes flickered, as if they were thinking of something.Luo Badao immediately glared at them and stopped their inappropriate thoughts.He has been around the world for many years and knows best what kind of people can be messed with and what kind of people cannot be messed with.This Chen Nan looks ordinary, but he can knock out three of them silently and dare to come to trade alone, so he must be no ordinary character.Chen Nan had a clear view of everything, and his evaluation of Luo Badao was a little higher.Although this person works in the black market, he knows how to assess the situation and knows what should be touched and what should not be touched. He is a person who can cooperate with him for a long time."Brother Dao, the deal is done, I'll take my leave now." Seeing that nothing happened to him, Chen Nan turned around and wanted to leave."Wait a minute." Luo Badao called to stop, then took a flashlight and handed it over."Brother Chen, it's late at night, please go back with a flashlight." Chen Nan was stunned and took the flashlight, "Brother Dao is still thoughtful." Flashlights were in short supply at this time, so he didn't expect the other party to give him one without hesitation."How much? How about I give you money?" "Who are you looking down on?" Luo Badao looked unhappy, "This is for you." Chen Nan smiled without saying anything, and left the woods with a flashlight.The night is getting darker, and the only sound left in the woods is the chirping of insects.Chen Nan's figure quickly disappeared into the darkness, leaving Luo Badao and his men facing mountains of pumpkins."Brother, just let him go like this?" A confidant couldn't help but asked, "Should we send someone to follow him and see where he came from?" Luo Badao shook his head: "No need. This young man is not simple. Following him will only alert the snake. What we do business with is integrity. As long as he can stillWe will treat you with courtesy as soon as you provide the supply." He squatted down and stroked the huge pumpkins, his eyes flashing: "This batch of pumpkins is enough for us to make a fortune.Let's go ahead and start selling them in batches tomorrow.There is no rush to cash in." "Yes!" A group of people responded in unison.At this time, Chen Nan had already walked out of the woods. After confirming that no one was following him, he slowed down.The moonlight shone on his body, and the evening breeze blew gently, bringing a slight chill.Chen Nan raised his lips slightly, with Luo Badao as a line, it would be much easier to get supplies in the future.When I got home, my parents were already asleep.Chen Nan quietly returned to his room, and then took out the wad of banknotes from the space.Two hundred and four "Great Unity" cards glowed with an attractive luster under the oil lamp. This was a huge amount of money that could change the fate of the family.I can only keep this money for myself for the time being. If my parents knew about it, I can't imagine what would happen.When the first ray of sunlight in the morning shines through the window paper, Chen Nan has been busy for a while.On the stove, golden eggs were mixed with white flour and baked into fragrant pancakes in an iron pot.He made this using the inventory in the space. Although it is simple, it can be regarded as a luxurious breakfast in this era."Oh, my little ancestor!" Li Xiulan came out of the back room with her coat on. When she saw the food on the stove, she suddenly felt distressed and slapped her thigh. "How many white eggs will be wasted in this meal!" She looked distressed, which made Chen Nan laugh a little, "MomDon't worry, our family will get better and better in the future." Chen Dongnan followed, looking at his son's busy figure, with a look of relief in his eyes: "If the child has a heart, you can enjoy it." It's a foregone conclusion. It's useless to talk anymore, so I can only wash up first.The family of three sat around the small table, and Chen Nan served each of his parents a large piece of egg pancake.Li Xiulan ate in small bites, saying "What a waste" every time she took a bite.Chen Southeast ate so much that he even picked up the crumbs that fell on the table and ate them."Dad, Mom, today I will go back to the countryside to see my grandparents and sisters." Chen Nan said while eating.Li Xiulan quickly put down her chopsticks and took out an envelope from the back room: "This is the letter of introduction issued by the street office, please keep it. Nowadays, you need a letter of introduction wherever you go. Without this, it is difficult to move forward." Chen Nan took the letter of introduction and carefully put it into his arms.In this day and age, without a letter of introduction, you can’t even get a ride in a car, let alone a hotel.Everyone is firmly fixed in their place of residence, and if they want to travel far, they must rely on this piece of paper to prove it."How about I take a leave and take you to the car?" Li Xiulan was a little worried."No! I'll just go to the station by myself. You can go to work without any worries." Chen Nan looked at his parents and said, "I'm old enough to take care of myself." Chen Nannan patted his son on the shoulder: "Be careful on the road, and send a message home when you get there." After the meal, the old couple went out to work.Chen Nan stood at the door, watching them disappear around the corner of the alley, and then turned back to the house.He took out the thirty feet of light blue cloth from the space.Putting the cloth in his parents' room, he found a piece of paper and wrote neatly: "Mom and Dad, I used fish to trade for this cloth. Don't worry, you can make new clothes to wear. Don't be reluctant to part with them. My grandparents and sisters will also have new clothes. I will take good care of myself and don't miss it." After writing the note, Chen Nan put the luggage he had packed into the space, locked the door, and walked towards the long-distance bus station.The station was bustling with people, filled with passengers carrying large and small bags.There was a long queue in front of the ticket window, and people were holding letters of introduction and banknotes tightly in their hands.Chen Nan queued for half an hour and finally bought a ticket to Red Star Commune.The bus was an old Jiefang brand bus. The carriage was packed with people and the aisles were piled with luggage.Chen Nan finally found his seat, but as soon as he sat down, he was hit by a smell that mixed with the smell of sweat, cigarette and chicken and duck, which made him frown.The car started and stopped, and people kept getting on and off, but the speed could not be increased.It was only forty or fifty miles from the capital to Hongxing Commune, but it took more than an hour by car.It can be seen that there are not many people getting off and on along the way, otherwise it would not be such a long ride for this short distance.Chen Nan got out of the car and looked at the unfamiliar environment, feeling a little dazed for a moment.Desolation and dilapidation are the only features. Compared with the capital, the crowds are far behind.He looked around for the bullock cart bound for the Victory Brigade.Unfortunately, after waiting for a long time, there was no sign of the bullock cart.There is still a distance of 14 to 5 miles from the commune to the Victory Brigade. Without an ox cart, we can only walk back.The June sun was very hot, and the dirt road was scalding hot.Chen Nan walked for almost an hour and was already sweating profusely when she got home.He found a shade to rest his feet and rested for ten minutes.When he was about to set off, he suddenly heard a strange noise coming from the forest beside the road."Crack, click, click..." It seemed like some large animal was chewing something.
